facts.fact: Vendor Adwave states a 30-second Super Bowl ad costs over $7 million.
facts.quote: a 30-second Super Bowl ad costs over $7 million.

facts.fact: Vendor Adwave states Super Bowl production for a polished spot can add another million or more.
facts.quote: which can easily add another million or more for the kind of polished spot

facts.fact: Vendor Adwave states the Super Bowl draws over 100 million viewers.
Vendor Adwave states CTV advertising typically costs $15-35 per thousand impressions (CPM), averaging around $25.
facts.quote: CTV advertising typically costs $15-35 per thousand impressions (CPM), with an average around $25.

facts.fact: Vendor Adwave estimates Super Bowl CPM at roughly $70 based on ad cost and viewership.
facts.quote: Compare that to the Super Bowl, where CPM works out to roughly $70 based on the ad cost and viewership.

facts.fact: Adwave states a CTV campaign with its platform can start at $30 a day.
facts.quote: launch a CTV campaign starting at just $30 a day.

facts.fact: Vendor Adwave states a 30-second local TV spot during local news or daytime programming might cost $200-1,500 depending on market and time slot.
facts.quote: A 30-second spot during local news or daytime programming might cost $200-1,500 depending on your market size and the time slot.

facts.fact: Vendor Adwave states a 60-second host-read podcast ad on a mid-size podcast might cost $500-2,000 per episode.
facts.quote: A 60-second host-read ad on a mid-size podcast might cost $500-2,000 per episode.

facts.fact: Vendor Adwave states programmatic podcast advertising CPMs are in the $15-25 range.
facts.quote: Programmatic podcast advertising through networks can be even more affordable, with CPMs in the $15-25 range.

facts.fact: Vendor Adwave states YouTube pre-roll ads are paid only when a viewer watches at least 30 seconds or engages with the ad.
facts.quote: you only pay when someone watches at least 30 seconds or engages with your ad.

facts.fact: Adwave states that its CTV advertising starts at $50.
facts.quote: Starting at $50, it's a fraction of what local TV costs and infinitely more accessible than the Super Bowl.

facts.fact: Adwave states that small businesses can start testing CTV advertising with it at $50.
facts.quote: CTV platforms like Adwave let you start at just $50, so testing is accessible.

facts.fact: Adwave's call to action describes its streaming advertising as starting at $30 a day.
Adwave states that it can launch TV-style commercials on more than 100 premium streaming channels.
Adwave states that it generates TV commercials from a URL in about 2 minutes.
facts.quote: Adwave generates TV commercials from any URL (your website, social profiles, or listings) in about 2 minutes.

facts.fact: The article cites unspecified marketing research as suggesting people need to see a brand message 7 or more times before it sticks.
facts.quote: Marketing research suggests people need to see a brand message 7+ times before it sticks.
